mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of the foreign shareholder

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille path: local notarization followed by Apostille certificate issued by the designated Competent Authority in an Apostille Convention state. Non-Apostille path: local notarization, authentication by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and PRC consular legalization. The paths are mutually exclusive and never sequential.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of Active Status of the foreign shareholder

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille path: local notarization followed by Apostille certificate issued by the designated Competent Authority. Non-Apostille path: local notarization, Ministry of Foreign Affairs authentication, and PRC consular legalization. Apostille and consular legalization are alternative routes only.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution / Power of Attorney authorizing formation of the WFOE
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors or corporate secretary of the foreign shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille path: notarized board resolution and Apostille by the relevant state authority. Non-Apostille path: notarized resolution, authentication by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and legalization at the PRC embassy or consulate. Never combine Apostille with consular legalization.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association / Certificate of Statutory Constitution of the foreign shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry authenticating the constituent document of the foreign shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille path: certified copy notarized and appended with Apostille. Non-Apostille path: certified copy notarized, authenticated by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and legalized by the PRC consulate. The two authentication routes are parallel and exclusive.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter for the foreign shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing bank / financial institution in the shareholder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille path: bank officer signature notarized and Apostilled. Non-Apostille path: bank officer signature notarized, authenticated by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and legalized by the PRC consular post. ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Before any incorporation filing, the compliance team must screen all shareholders, directors, legal representatives, UBOs, and authorized signatories against the UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List, OFAC SDN and Non-SDN Lists, China's Ministry of Commerce restricted and prohibited entity lists, the EU consolidated financial sanctions list, and the domestic PEP database maintained by the People's Bank of China. Enhanced due diligence must apply to politically exposed persons, family members, close associates, and adverse-media hits. All screening results must be time-stamped, source-cited, updated within 24 hours before formation, and retained for at least five years.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: SAMR Enterprise Name Independent Declaration System, accessed through the provincial State Administration for Market Regulation online registration platform
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The registered name must be in standardized simplified Chinese characters and follow a four-tier structure: administrative division, unique trade name, industry or business scope descriptor, and legal form suffix 'Limited Liability Company'. Latin letters, traditional Chinese characters, and non-standard numerals are not accepted in the statutory Chinese name. A foreign shareholder name from a traditional-Chinese jurisdiction must be converted to simplified Chinese using the official cross-strait standard conversion table. The English name of the WFOE may be used only as a supplementary non-statutory alias for banking and invoicing purposes.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant will receive a written notice stating the legal basis. The applicant may first resubmit an amended name declaration through the SAMR online portal or file an administrative reconsideration petition with the local SAMR's superior administrative authority within 60 days from the date of the rejection notice under the Administrative Reconsideration Law. The petition must include the original rejection notice, a corrected proposed name, investor identity and UBO documents, and a memorandum explaining why the name is not prohibited. If reconsideration fails, the applicant may bring administrative litigation within six months. The name reservation cannot be extended beyond the initial 30-day window unless the applicant files a new declaration.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A pure virtual office or commercial mailbox is rejected by the local SAMR and tax authorities for this B2B enterprise SaaS WFOE. The registered address must be a physical premises in mainland China that is leased or owned and capable of receiving official correspondence. Some municipal tax bureaus accept serviced offices with dedicated workstations and a fixed meeting room if a genuine lease, mail-handling contract, and on-site manager are documented; a bare mail-forwarding address creates a high risk that the tax registration is placed in abnormal-operation status. The registered address must be in the same administrative division as the reviewing SAMR bureau, and the lease term must cover at least one year. Free-trade-zone virtual-address schemes are available only for approved industrial categories and not for a standard WFOE generating ordinary VAT and CIT filings.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Risk Level: low-to-moderate for a standard software WFOE with less than RMB 5 million annual turnover, with an estimated 15-25% probability of an unannounced on-site check within the first 12 months; the risk rises to 35-50% if the entity applies for an export/import registration, makes large cross-strait intra-group service payments, or claims preferential software tax treatment. Checklist: (1) company nameplate posted at the registered address; (2) accessible reception displaying the business license; (3) original lease agreement, rental receipts, and property management confirmation; (4) at least two employees present during working hours; (5) furniture, computers, servers, and equipment consistent with enterprise software development; (6) utility bills matching a one-year lease continuity; (7) financial ledgers and VAT records accessible; (8) e-invoicing system active; (9) registered address identical to the tax filing address; (10) no mailbox-only indicator in the corporate registry. Municipal tax bureaus and market regulation inspectors conduct unscheduled visits under the double random, one public inspection regime.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Taiwan Company Act (2018 consolidated version), Articles 1, 10, 128, 129, 130, 131, 156, 192, 208, 218, and 387; Foreign Investment Act, Articles 7-10; and where the ultimate investor is a People's Republic of China resident entity, the Regulations Governing Investment in Taiwan by People of the Mainland Area.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Company Registration Division, Department of Commercial and Industrial Services, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), Taiwan; Investment Commission, MOEA for foreign or mainland investment approval.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Registration of a Company Limited by Shares under Article 387 of the Taiwan Company Act, together with the Foreign Investment Approval Letter or Mainland Investment Approval Letter, the approved Articles of Incorporation, and the capital verification report.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: None under the Taiwan Company Act as currently amended. The company must, however, fully subscribe and pay its stated share capital before registration, and a Taiwan-licensed certified public accountant must issue a capital verification report. Funds must be remitted through a designated foreign exchange bank and maintained in a company-name capital or operating account; no statutory blocked escrow account is required. The capital amount must be adequate for the enterprise SaaS business plan and acceptable to the Investment Commission in connection with the foreign or mainland investment approval.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: The undersigned, being the sole incorporator and initial shareholder of the Company, a company limited by shares to be formed under the laws of Taiwan, acting by written consent in lieu of an organizing meeting pursuant to the Taiwan Company Act and the proposed Articles of Incorporation, hereby adopt the following First Board of Directors Resolution on the date set forth below. 1. Share Capital Subscription. RESOLVED, that the authorized share capital of the Company be fixed at New Taiwan Dollars [●], divided into [●] ordinary shares with par value New Taiwan Dollars Ten per share, and that the full issued capital of New Taiwan Dollars [●] be subscribed by the sole shareholder and accepted by the Board. The Chairman and Chief Financial Officer are instructed to deposit the full subscription monies into a capital contribution account in the Company's name and to procure a capital verification report from a Taiwan-licensed certified public accountant before the registration filing. 2. Banking Authorization. RESOLVED, that the Company shall open and maintain its principal operating, foreign currency, and payroll bank accounts with [●] Bank, Taiwan. The Chairman together with the Chief Financial Officer, or any two directors acting jointly, are hereby authorized to execute all account opening applications, know-your-client declarations, signature cards, authorized signatory forms, wire transfer instructions, electronic banking mandates, cheques, and deposit agreements on behalf of the Company, subject to a dual-signature threshold for payments above New Taiwan Dollars [●]. 3. Registered Office. RESOLVED, that the registered office and statutory address for service of process of the Company shall be located at [●], Taiwan, and that the Company Secretary shall post the company name at such office, prepare the consent of the landlord or proof of ownership, and file the address with the Ministry of Economic Affairs together with the registration application. 4. Statutory Officer Appointments. RESOLVED, that [●] be and is hereby appointed Chairman of the Board; [●] be and is hereby appointed General Manager and Chief Executive Officer; [●] be and is hereby appointed Chief Financial Officer; [●] be and is hereby appointed Company Secretary; and, if required by the Articles, [●] be and is hereby appointed Inspector. Each appointee accepts office and confirms that no statutory disqualification exists under Article 30 of the Taiwan Company Act. 5. Execution and Filing. RESOLVED, that the Chairman and Company Secretary, acting jointly, be and they are hereby authorized to prepare, execute, notarize where necessary, and file all incorporation documents, including the Articles of Incorporation, shareholders minutes, capital verification report, foreign investment approval letter, company registration application, and related forms with the Ministry of Economic Affairs, and to pay all fees and obtain the Unified Business Number. This resolution shall remain in full force and effect until the earlier of completion of the registration and the first annual general meeting.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Foreign Investment Approval and Name Pre-Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), Taiwan; MOEA Company Name and Business Scope Pre-Review System.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an online application through the MOEA foreign investment or mainland investment portal. The application must include the parent corporation's board resolution authorizing the Taiwan subsidiary, certified constitutional documents of the parent, audited financial statements, a bank reference letter, a proposed Taiwan registered address or lease commitment, and a detailed description of the proposed enterprise cloud software development and B2B enterprise SaaS licensing business. Simultaneously apply for business name and business scope pre-approval through the MOEA name review system. If the proposed name is identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered entity, the system will reject it. The application must be signed by an authorized attorney and supported by an executed power of attorney. ISIC 6201 software development is a permissible activity for 100% foreign or mainland ownership, subject to negative-list screening and investment approval.
required_dossiers: Foreign Investment or Mainland Investment Application Form
Certificate of Incorporation of the parent company
Articles of Association or constitutional documents of the parent
Parent board resolution authorizing Taiwan subsidiary
Audited financial statements for the last fiscal year
Bank reference letter for the investing parent
Proposed Taiwan company name and business scope
Power of Attorney in favor of local attorney or agent
Lease intent or registered office address proof
Photocopies of directors and shareholder identification or passports
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Investment Commission issues a deficiency notice, the applicant has 30 calendar days from the date of notice to cure and resubmit the missing items. If the application is suspended for negative-list review, provide supplementary declarations on software licensing, data localization, and permitted foreign ownership, and request a formal administrative reconsideration within 30 days of the suspension decision.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Articles of Incorporation and Organizational Resolutions
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Taiwan-licensed attorney and optional notary public in Taiwan; final filing with MOEA occurs in a later step.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a Taiwan-licensed attorney to draft the Articles of Incorporation in compliance with Articles 129, 130, and 131 of the Taiwan Company Act. The sole incorporator must approve the articles and adopt the initial shareholders meeting minutes, including the issuance of shares, the election of the first directors and inspector if required, and the adoption of the First Board of Directors Resolution. All signatures must be original; corporate shareholders must execute through authorized representatives and attach certified constitutional documents. Individual directors must sign personal consent letters. Notarization of signatures is strongly recommended for bank know-your-client screening and MOEA acceptance. The articles must state the authorized and issued share capital, par value, business scope, registered office, board size, method of calling shareholders meetings, and officers of the Company. Any subsequent change before registration requires a further unanimous shareholder resolution.
required_dossiers: Draft Articles of Incorporation approved by the sole shareholder
Initial Shareholders Meeting Minutes
First Board of Directors Resolution
Directors and Inspector Letters of Consent
Foreign Investment or Mainland Investment Approval Letter
Power of Attorney executed by the parent
Identification or passport copies of directors and shareholders
Registered office address proof or lease agreement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If MOEA or the notary objects to the articles for missing mandatory clauses, the articles must be amended by a supplementary shareholder resolution and re-executed or re-notarized. If any non-statutory provision is determined to create ambiguity or violate public policy, delete the provision and refile the corrected articles before proceeding.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Capital Contribution and CPA Capital Verification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Designated foreign exchange bank in Taiwan and a Taiwan-licensed certified public accountant (CPA).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After obtaining the investment approval letter, the parent remits the full share subscription amount to a temporary capital contribution account opened in the Company's name at a Taiwanese bank. The bank must verify the remitter, the source of funds, and the investment approval letter, and must issue a bank deposit certificate or foreign exchange settlement certificate. A Taiwan-licensed CPA then reviews the bank certificate, the approved investment amount, the shareholders register, the articles of incorporation, and applicable exchange rate records, and issues a formal capital verification report. The funds need not be placed in a blocked escrow account, but they must remain in the Company account and may not be withdrawn for other purposes until the company registration is completed and the CPA report is filed with MOEA. The TWD equivalent of any foreign currency remittance must equal or exceed the subscribed capital.
required_dossiers: Foreign Investment or Mainland Investment Approval Letter
Bank deposit certificate from the Taiwanese bank
Foreign exchange remittance or settlement certificate
CPA capital verification report
Company articles and shareholder list
Bank account opening documents and signature cards
Source of funds and AML/KYC compliance declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank rejects the remittance due to incomplete anti-money laundering or know-your-client documentation, provide the bank with the investment approval letter, parent corporate certificate, ultimate beneficial owner declarations, and an updated power of attorney. If the CPA declines to certify because the full amount has not been collected, top up the capital account and obtain a revised bank deposit certificate before resubmitting to the CPA.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Company Registration and Unified Business Number Issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company Registration Division, Department of Commercial and Industrial Services, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), Taiwan.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the complete incorporation package with MOEA through the company registration online portal or in person at the commercial services counter. The package must include the completed company registration application, the approved Articles of Incorporation, shareholders minutes, First Board of Directors Resolution, the CPA capital verification report, the investment approval letter, the name pre-approval certificate, address proof, director and inspector consent letters, and the fee payment voucher. MOEA will review the documents for legal formality, mandatory clauses, and consistency with the approved investment scope. Upon approval, MOEA issues the Company Registration Certificate and assigns the Unified Business Number. The Company must then apply for tax registration with the National Taxation Bureau using the same Unified Business Number. The registered business scope should expressly include enterprise cloud software application development and B2B SaaS platform services so that no separate operating license is required.
required_dossiers: Company registration application form
Approved Articles of Incorporation
Initial Shareholders Meeting Minutes and First Board Resolution
CPA capital verification report
Foreign Investment or Mainland Investment Approval Letter
Name and business scope pre-approval certificate
Registered office lease, ownership proof, or landlord consent
Director and shareholder identification documents
Company chop and signature specimen card
Fee payment voucher
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If MOEA issues a correction notice, the company has 15 days from issuance to cure the defects unless an extension is granted. The company must amend the inconsistent clauses, re-certify any affected financial documents, and resubmit through the same portal. If registration is denied, the company may request a written ruling and file an administrative appeal within 30 days while simultaneously curing the stated substantive defects.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration, Social Insurance, and Digital Services Compliance Filings
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Taxation Bureau, Ministry of Finance, Taiwan; Bureau of Labor Insurance and National Health Insurance Administration for payroll; municipal workplace safety authorities.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Using the Company Registration Certificate and Unified Business Number, register the Company with the National Taxation Bureau for profit-seeking enterprise income tax, business tax, withholding tax, and uniform invoice issuance. If the B2B SaaS services are exported to overseas customers, apply to treat the cross-border service revenue as zero-rated business tax and maintain all customer contracts, export service statements, and payment records. Register the Company as an employer with the labor insurance and national health insurance authorities if any Taiwan employees are hired, and implement workplace safety, data protection, and payroll compliance policies. No industrial license, environmental impact assessment, or civil defense fire permit is required because the Company operates a pure digital enterprise software business with no manufacturing, chemical, assembly, or warehousing facilities.
required_dossiers: Company Registration Certificate and Unified Business Number
Profit-seeking enterprise and business tax registration forms
Shareholder and director register
Lease or ownership proof for tax office record
Bank account details
Employment contracts and social insurance registration forms
B2B SaaS customer agreements and export service records for zero-rating
Privacy policy and data processing documentation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax office flags the Company as inactive or dormant, submit a written explanation together with the First Board Resolution, bank account statements, and prospective customer contracts to demonstrate active business purpose. If the zero-rated VAT application is challenged, provide the foreign customer registration evidence and detailed service export documentation, and if necessary file a formal protest with the National Taxation Bureau within 30 days of the adverse determination.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not Applicable - the business is ISIC 6201 enterprise cloud software and B2B SaaS, a pure digital and consulting activity with no physical manufacturing, chemical, assembly, or warehousing operations.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not Applicable - no industrial operating or manufacturing permit is required.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Not Applicable - exempt from environmental impact assessment because the Company has no industrial installation, chemical process, combustion source, or physical discharge.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not Applicable - zero industrial wastewater, VOC, or hazardous waste streams. For decommissioned IT equipment, the Company must follow Taiwan Waste Disposal Act and resource recycling rules for e-waste, batteries, and electronic media.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not Applicable - no civil defense fire safety permit is required for a pure SaaS digital office. The Company must still comply with the Taiwan Occupational Safety and Health Act and Building Act fire safety requirements for office premises, including fire extinguishers, emergency exits, exit lighting, and first aid readiness.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) of the People's Republic of China; electronic tax filing portal: https://tpass.chinatax.gov.cn/ (e-Tax Bureau)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Upon incorporation with the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR), the WFOE automatically receives a Unified Social Credit Code (USCC) which serves as its Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN). The company must complete tax registration with the local tax authority within 30 days of obtaining the business license, submitting the incorporation certificate, articles of association, legal representative identification, and proof of registered address. The tax authority issues a tax registration certificate and activates the TIN. For foreign non-resident entities without a permanent establishment, a simplified VAT registration is required if they have taxable activities in China, but a WFOE is a resident entity and follows the standard procedure.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: People's Bank of China (PBOC) acting through the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The People's Republic of China operates a managed floating exchange-rate regime under PBOC/SAFE. The current-account item is broadly convertible for bona fide trade and services: the WFOE may receive B2B SaaS subscription revenue from overseas clients and, after bank verification of contract, invoice, and service delivery, may retain the foreign exchange in a current-account deposit or settle it into RMB. Capital-account transactions, however, are not freely convertible. FDI capital contributions from the Taiwan parent must enter through a SAFE-registered capital account and cannot be settled into RMB until the bank confirms the underlying investment documents and intended use under the payment-to-use negative list. Prohibited uses include entrusted loans, repayment of onshore RMB loans from non-affiliates, equity investment outside the approved scope, and non-owner-occupied real estate except with SAFE exception. Profit remittance is lawful but gated: the WFOE must complete the annual statutory audit, file corporate income tax, settle tax liabilities, document distributable profits, and present a board resolution to the remitting bank. The bank will verify that the dividend is not persistently funded by hedge or circular flows and will apply the applicable dividend withholding tax for the Taiwanese shareholder before outward remittance.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under SAFE trade and services foreign exchange administration, export and software service-trade receipts must be repatriated into mainland China within 180 days after customs declaration for goods or after service completion/invoice date for B2B SaaS services, unless SAFE has approved offshore retention. There is currently no mandatory conversion ratio: 100% of collected foreign exchange may be kept in a current-account foreign currency deposit or sold to a designated bank for RMB at market rate. The bank must complete trade verification using the executed software contract, commercial invoice, access/delivery evidence, and VAT/tax documentation before settlement.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low viability as a primary treasury rail. The PRC legal framework reserves foreign-exchange settlement, payments, and current/capital account clearing to licensed designated banks. Offshore digital EMIs (including Wise B2B and Stripe Billing) cannot open a recognized domestic settlement account in the WFOE's name, cannot provide SAFE-compliant FX purpose codes, and would cause a violation of repatriation if used as the final receiving rail. The configured Stripe_Billing and Wise_B2B rails may be used only as front-end collection gateways for the offshore group, and funds must ultimately be wired to the mainland WFOE's designated bank through SWIFT with correct trade documentation. A licensed third-party payment institution may be engaged for small-value current-account collection, but it must clear through a domestic bank and cannot replace the corporate banking relationship.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is mandatory for first-time account opening. The WFOE's legal representative or the authorized financial officer with a notarized board resolution must appear in person at the designated bank branch in mainland China, bring original passports and identity documents, company chops, business license, articles of association, FDI registration confirmation, proof of registered office, and the Taiwan parent's corporate registry documents authenticated for use in mainland China. Remote consular proxy opening is not accepted for new corporate accounts under current SAFE-governed bank KYC policies; after onboarding, limited power-of-attorney arrangements may be accepted for follow-up transactions, but the first substantive interview cannot be delegated.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Nominee or layered ownership structure concealing the Taiwan parent's ultimate beneficial owners.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full ownership chain chart from the WFOE through the Taiwan parent to each natural person owning 25% or more; certified Taiwan business registry extract and audited financial statements; notarized board resolutions; signed UBO declarations and identity documents; trust deed summary and source-of-wealth statement for any trust/nominee holding.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High or rushed FDI capital injection from Taiwan relative to SaaS revenue and headcount, raising round-tripping or unlawful cross-border guarantee concerns.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Parent treasury approval, parent bank statements and audited financials; WFOE business plan and three-year financial projections; board resolution authorizing contribution; SAFE FDI registration certificate; capital contribution schedule in the articles; anti-round-tripping declaration confirming no mainland-derived funds are recycled through Taiwan.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Intangible SaaS export has no customs bill of lading, causing bank/SAFE verification to suspect fabricated trade when settling receivables or purchasing FX.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed enterprise B2B contracts, service orders, commercial invoices, VAT invoices where applicable, customer sign-offs, cloud-hosting and usage logs, project milestone reports, and transfer pricing documentation where counterparties include the Taiwan parent or affiliates.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions, PEP, or cross-strait national-security screening triggered by Taiwan ownership and export-control concerns for software supply chains.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Sanctions/PEP self-declarations from all directors and UBOs; independent negative-media and sanctions screening; certified Taiwan registry documents; end-use/end-user certification; restricted-technology checklist demonstrating no military, surveillance, or nuclear application; willingness to accept enhanced monitoring and transaction covenants.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The Taiwan parent must transmit paid-in capital by SWIFT MT103 to the WFOE's SAFE-registered FDI capital account at the designated bank, citing the purpose of payment as 'FDI registered capital injection for CN_WFOE_LTD' with the applicable SAFE FX transaction code. The WFOE must complete FDI information registration before the remittance, and the bank must verify the business license, articles of association, board resolution, and FDI registration certificate. Upon receipt, the bank records the credit as paid-in capital and, if required by the bank or by a future lender, a Chinese CPA capital verification report is issued. Settlement of the capital into RMB must follow the payment-to-use negative list and be applied only to payroll, cloud infrastructure, software development, taxes, and ordinary operating expenses, not to entrusted loans, equity investment, or real estate outside the approved business scope.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For legitimate outbound SaaS disbursements—cloud provider charges, overseas subcontractors, Taiwan parent license fees, and technology royalties—the WFOE must instruct a SWIFT MT103 remittance from its designated bank and submit the service contract, invoice, tax withholding certificate, and proof of actual service delivery for SAFE service-trade verification. Commercial letters of credit and documentary collections are not suitable for ordinary SaaS subscription transactions because the service is intangible; they may be used only in hybrid software distribution arrangements that involve physical media, master license ownership, or organized goods movement. Direct bank remittance with correct transaction codes is the primary clearing rail for the WFOE's operating treasury.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable RMB/foreign-currency forward contracts executed with a SAFE-designated bank on a real current-account or approved capital-account exposure
Plain-vanilla RMB/FX swaps and cross-currency swaps used to hedge balance-sheet exposure from the Taiwan parent capital injection or recurring USD-denominated SaaS fees
FX option collars, call spreads, and put spreads with genuine underlying, no naked option-selling, and tenor aligned to forecast cash flows
Onshore rolling forward structures restructured from deliverable forwards, subject to bank credit lines and SAFE documentation

Offshore CNH non-deliverable forwards are not permissible as direct contracts for the mainland WFOE; any NDF hedging may be executed only at the offshore Taiwan parent level and cannot involve RMB delivery into the mainland banking system

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Foreign-Invested Enterprise Business and Financial Condition Report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), Taiwan
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within three months after the fiscal year end; for a calendar-year company, on or before March 31 of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to submit may trigger a warning from the Investment Commission, suspension of profit remittance rights for the foreign investor, administrative fines under the Statute for Investment by Foreign Nationals, and in severe cases revocation of the foreign investment approval.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Taxation Bureau, Ministry of Finance, Taiwan (territorial jurisdiction of the company registered office)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: May 1 through May 31 of the following tax year for a calendar-year taxpayer
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of 3% of the underpaid tax amount; late payment interest at the 2-year postal deposit rate plus 1 percentage point per annum; enforced collection including bank garnishment and asset liens after 30 days; persistent noncompliance can lead to an MOEA-ordered strike-off of the corporate registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual General Meeting or Shareholders Written Consent Approving Financial Statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Not filed as such; minutes kept at registered office and audited financial statements, if required, sent to MOEA within 15 days after approval
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months after the fiscal year end; for a calendar-year company, by June 30
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Company Act Article 170 empowers the competent authority to fine responsible directors or administrators NT$20,000 to NT$1,000,000 and order compliance within a specified period; continued noncompliance may result in escalating daily penalties.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Principal Shareholder and Beneficial Owner Information Filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs, Company Registration Division (Beneficial Ownership Register)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after incorporation, and within 30 days after any qualifying transfer of shares or change in beneficial ownership; no separate annual filing is required but annual re-confirmation is a statutory governance obligation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Under Company Act Article 22-1, failure to file or updating inaccuracies can result in fines of NT$50,000 to NT$500,000 for the company or its responsible officers, and false declarations may expose the company to criminal penalties for fraudulent registration.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: An independent CPA audit is legally mandatory under Taiwan Company Act Article 20 and the Regulations on the Scope of Financial Statements Audited by Certified Public Accountants for any of the following: (i) paid-in capital exceeding NT$30 million (approx. USD 1 million) as of the balance sheet date; (ii) annual revenue exceeding NT$100 million (approx. USD 3.3 million); (iii) a company whose shares are listed, OTC-listed, or otherwise publicly issued; or (iv) a foreign-invested enterprise whose FDI approval conditions require audited financial statements to be submitted to the Investment Commission, MOEA. The Ministry of Finance may also demand a CPA audit where taxable revenue exceeds statutory thresholds or where special investment tax incentives are claimed.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Taiwan-IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards as adopted by the Financial Supervisory Commission) for statutory financial reporting; small and medium-sized limited companies may use the Business Entity Accounting Act and the Taiwan SME Financial Reporting Standards, but a CN-owned wholly foreign-owned enterprise in Taiwan should apply Taiwan-IFRS to maintain consistency with consolidated group reporting.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under Company Act Article 22-1, Taiwan requires non-public companies to establish and maintain a beneficial ownership register for shareholders and ultimate beneficial owners holding 10% or more of shares or controlling interest. Any change in shareholding or beneficial ownership must be filed with the MOEA Company Registration Division within 30 days of the transfer. While no standalone annual UBO filing exists, the company must re-confirm and update its beneficial ownership data at least annually, and the Investment Commission annual report for foreign-invested enterprises effectively mandates an annual declaration of the shareholding structure.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (shareholders and transfer ledger)
Register of Directors and Supervisors (where applicable)
Register of Pledges over Shares and Charges
Minute Book of Shareholders Meetings and Board Resolutions

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 15% preferential rate for qualified high-tech software enterprises

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Corporate Income Tax Return Form (企业所得税纳税申报表) filed electronically through the State Taxation Administration e-filing platform
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 5 months after the end of the fiscal year

field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Aggregate all revenue from Chinese operations; exclude foreign parent dividends
Include arm's length related party expenses; apply TP adjustments
Calculate after all allowable deductions and incentives

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing surcharge of RMB 2,000 per day (maximum 10 days); additional penalty of 50% of underpaid tax; criminal prosecution for willful evasion exceeding RMB 1 million

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No bilateral tax treaty exists between China and Taiwan; standard 10% WHT applies to dividends remitted to Taiwanese parent; no TRC submission required

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Economic Substance Regulations do not apply to B2B enterprise SaaS operations; primarily relevant for intellectual property holding companies

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Underreporting taxable income or false expense claims
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative penalties up to 5 times the evaded tax; criminal liability with imprisonment for amounts exceeding RMB 1 million
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Joint and several civil liability for restitution; possible criminal charges, fines, and disqualification

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to maintain or apply arm's length transfer pricing documentation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalties of 5 times the additional tax assessed; backdated adjustments
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal fines and potential imprisonment for willful misconduct

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Improper cross-border fund flows without proper KYC or suspicious transaction reporting
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines up to RMB 500,000 or criminal liability under AML law

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining WFOE without genuine business operations or economic substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Reclassification as foreign enterprise; back taxes and penalties
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Piercing of corporate veil; civil damages and criminal sanctions
